2607.24137.title: BioSentinel at EXIST 2026: Soft-Label Optimization with XLM-RoBERTa for Sexism Intent Classification in Memes
2607.24137.paper_summary: This paper describes the BioSentinel team's participation in EXIST 2026 Task 2.2: Source Intention in Memes, part of the CLEF 2026 evaluation campaign. The task requires classifying the communicative intent behind memes as direct, judgemental, or no (non-sexist), under a Learning with Disagreement (Le-Wi-Di) paradigm that mandates both hard-label and soft-label (probability distribution) predictions. We present a text-centric approach built on xlm-roberta-base (270M parameters) trained with a composite loss function combining KL divergence on soft annotator distributions and weighted cross-entropy on hard labels. On the official test set, the system achieved an ICM-Soft-Norm of 0.3229 and ICM-Norm of 0.3778, with a hard F1-score of 0.4236, ranking 40th (out of 118 submissions) in the soft-soft evaluation and 49th (out of 187 submissions) in the hard-hard evaluation. We provide an analysis of the dataset characteristics, exploratory larger-architecture runs, and the role of annotator disagreement in shaping model design for subjective NLP tasks. Ablation results show that KL loss improves soft-label metrics, while CE loss improves hard-label accuracy. We also report a separate validation-set temperature analysis.
2607.24137.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了BioSentinel團隊參加EXIST 2026任務2.2：迷因中的來源意圖，這是CLEF 2026評估活動的一部分。<lb/>該任務要求將迷因背後的傳達意圖分類為直接、判斷性或無（非性別歧視），在一個要求同時進行硬標籤和軟標籤（概率分佈）預測的學習與分歧（Le-Wi-Di）範式下進行。<lb/>我們提出了一種基於文本的中心方法，建立在xlm-roberta-base（270M參數）之上，並使用一種綜合損失函數進行訓練，該函數結合了對軟標註者分佈的KL散度和對硬標籤的加權交叉熵。<lb/>在官方測試集上，系統達到了ICM-Soft-Norm 0.3229和ICM-Norm 0.3778，硬F1分數為0.4236，在軟-軟評估中排名第40（共118次提交），在硬-硬評估中排名第49（共187次提交）。<lb/>我們提供了數據集特徵的分析、探索性的大型架構運行，以及標註者分歧在塑造主觀NLP任務模型設計中的作用。<lb/>消融結果顯示，KL損失改善了軟標籤指標，而CE損失改善了硬標籤準確性。<lb/>我們還報告了一個單獨的驗證集溫度分析。
